notes: Raised post-#676 (issue closed; coverage work continues as an open-ended goal per owner request — full_min_percent is the metric that matters, unit_min_percent/CI enforcement is not a target). This batch broadens the discourse/ subpackage's 4 Phase-4-era modules (formulaic.py, information_structure.py, speech_acts.py, stylometrics.py), each of which previously had only one behavioral test, to their full public API. Also fixes a real bug found while broadening speech_acts.py: _OT_ASSERTIVE_LEMMAS used the pointed Tetragrammaton 'יְהוָה', which matches only 1 stray token corpus-wide (this corpus stores it unpointed, 'יהוה' — same root cause as the earlier formulaic.py HEBREW_FORMULAS fix); this silently dropped the divine-name assertive cue for ~1,795 verses. unit_min_percent unchanged at 12.56% (all new tests are integration-marked). full_min_percent measured in the regular fully-provisioned dev venv, raised 67.05% -> 69.18%. Next targets: intertextuality/intertextuality.py + lxx_consistency.py (original modules, distinct from the 3 new ones already broadened), lexical/hapax.py (no test file at all — missed in the earlier lexical/ batch), verbal_syntax/ remainder, names/role_search.py remaining gaps, core/ plumbing modules. Update only via `scripts/check_coverage.py --update-baseline`, in the same PR that earns the increase — see docs/policies/test-coverage.md.
